items.text: All round-2 decisions incorporated into the plan: (1) git_commit_hash column is nullable TEXT with NULL for legacy rows, app-layer enforcement for new creates (d1=B); (2) orphaned ApprovalID field removed from validation.Record struct (d2=A); (3) reviewer identity defaults to 'operator' when not provided, proper identity deferred to follow-up (d3=A); (4) SubmitReview response enriched with approval_id and approval_status fields, eliminating extra API calls for the primary UI flow (d4=A).

Pre-existing atomicity bug identified and addressed: ApprovalsRepository.Create() calls MarkStale() outside any transaction. The Phase 2 DBTX refactor fixes this as a side-effect — when called via WithTx(), both MarkStale and INSERT run within the caller's transaction.

All 5 readiness dimensions scored at 3/3. Problem is well-defined (two disconnected subsystems with an unused FK as the designed join point). Scope is bounded to scenarios/deployment-manager/** with explicit out-of-scope items. Approach uses established Go patterns (DBTX interface, WithTx). Testing plan covers unit, integration (testcontainers), and UI layers. Risks are cataloged with mitigations, including the migration strategy for legacy data.

Plan is ready for execution. The 5-phase implementation (schema → DBTX infra → bridging logic → UI → CLI) has clear file-level change lists and no remaining TBD sections. Definition of Done has 13 concrete criteria.

plan_updates: Incorporated round-2 decisions: nullable git_commit_hash column (d1=B), removed orphaned ApprovalID (d2=A), default reviewer 'operator' (d3=A), enriched SubmitReview response (d4=A). Updated Scope, Implementation Strategy Phase 1/3/4, Contract Decisions (added Type changes and Reviewer identity sections), Testing Plan (added legacy/reviewer/response-enrichment test cases), Risks table (updated migration risk, added reviewer placeholder risk), and Definition of Done (expanded from 9 to 13 criteria). No remaining gaps.
